name: outline-view
author: lumine-code
description: Show a hierarchical symbol outline of the active editor.

visitEntriesOnKeyboardMovement.title: Visit Entries On Keyboard Movement
visitEntriesOnKeyboardMovement.description: Reveal symbols in the editor whenever their entries in the outline are visited with core keyboard commands. If disabled, you must use `Enter` (or its equivalent) to reveal a symbol after it has been focused.

showOnRightSide.title: Show On Right Side
showOnRightSide.description: When enabled, the outline appears in the right dock by default instead of the left dock.

ignoredSymbolTypes.title: Ignored Symbol Types
ignoredSymbolTypes.description: A comma-separated list of symbol types to ignore, keyed on a symbol's `icon` or `tag`. Hover over a symbol in the outline; if a string appears in parentheses in the tooltip, that value can be used to ignore that kind of symbol. All descendants of an ignored symbol are also ignored.

nameOverflowStrategy.title: Name Overflow Strategy
nameOverflowStrategy.description: What to do when an item's name is too long to fit in the dock. The `scroll` option overflows and adds a horizontal scrollbar; the `ellipsis` option truncates the symbol name with an ellipsis.
